subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should `maxToolCallingRounds` permanently reject configured runs using any non-built-in harness, or should harnesses advertise and prove equivalent round-limit support?
rationale: This choice defines public config behavior and whether enabling a safety control disables an otherwise selected runtime; code correctness alone cannot establish the intended contract.

options.title: Harness capability contract
options.body: Allow harnesses to opt into the same pre-tool round enforcement and tool-free closeout semantics through an explicit capability.

options.title: Built-in only
options.body: Keep the current preflight rejection and clearly document that enabling the key makes non-built-in harnesses unavailable.

options.title: Defer the config
options.body: Pause or remove the public key until cross-harness behavior has an owner-approved design.

recommendation.title: Harness capability contract
recommendation.body: Allow harnesses to opt into the same pre-tool round enforcement and tool-free closeout semantics through an explicit capability.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the current runner integration and are the strongest available owner for the remaining harness-boundary decision.
